name: What considerations should I make when choosing between a three-season and four-season sunroom?

mainEntity.name: What considerations should I make when choosing between a three-season and four-season sunroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: When planning a sunroom addition, deciding between a three-season or four-season room is a critical choice driven by your intended use and budget. A three-season room is typically less insulated and not designed for extreme temperatures, making it suitable for spring, summer, and fall enjoyment. A four-season room, however, is built with insulated glass and often integrated into your home's HVAC system, providing comfort year-round. AKN Design Group can guide you through the material and system implications of each option, helping you make a decision that aligns with your lifestyle and comfort expectations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a three-season sunroom for seasonal use or a four-season room for year-round comfort with integrated climate control.
